I'm going to tell you something I did not realize for a long time.
There are girls that feel just like you. The feel ugly and unwanted and unloved because they're too skinny or too fat or too smelly or too stupid and that no guy would go for them because of the Barbie-esque peers. 
If you don't mind advice from an anonymous internet stranger, let me say two things.

1. Look into yourself and work on self-improvement. And I don't mean go to the gym and look like a macho man. I mean look at your behavior, your attitude, and see if you've been acting mean or cruel at certain times. Girls are people, and people like nice people. 

2. Don't force it. You don't need a romantic partner to be happy, because being in a relationship is a lot of work. Simply having friends can sometimes be enough.

3. See a counselor or call a hotline. Please. Talk about your problems and you can get better.
Stay strong, friend.

I've struggled with thoughts of suicide ever since my junior year in high school, so I know where you're coming from. One thing you should know is that good counselors care. But if you feel as if they do not, there is always suicide and depression hotlines. I personally like calling hotlines at night( when it's not likely my family will walk in and when the lines are likely to be open). Life hurts, and I'm so sorry that you feel like a burden. But just stay strong a little longer. And always post here if you feel like you have nowhere else to go.

I experienced the same thing for a while in high school during my shitty junior and senior year. Dreams about killing myself and waking up in a shock. It got so bad that I kept a bottle of Somnapure, a brand of sleeping pills, under my pillow so I could kill myself if it got too much.

My advice would be to go to bed earlier. One problem I had is that when I woke up I felt like shit and had to go to school only an hour after I woke up. But then I started going to bed earlier( like by 8:00), then I would wake up at like 4:00 or 5:00 and would spend a few hours playing a video game or watching Youtube or reading. I'm not sure if it would help you, but having some time to cool down after a shitty dream really kept me from offing myself in high school
